pages.text: A very compact ball of matter.$(br2)Made with 256,000 items or buckets in a $(l:items_blocks_machines/condenser)Matter Condenser$(/l) in singularity mode.$(br2)$(bold)Quantum Entangled Singularity$()

Required to create a connection between two $(l:items_blocks_machines/quantum_bridge)Quantum Network Bridges$(/l), they are always produced in matching pairs. To create a connection place 1 of the pair of quantum entangled singularities into the $(l:items_blocks_machines/quantum_bridge)ME Quantum Link Chamber$(/l) of the bridge on each side.$(br2)They are crafted by causing a reaction between $(item)Ender Pearl$()
or $(l:items_blocks_machines/ender_dust)Ender Dust$(/l)\ and a $(item)Singularity$(). Any explosive force should be enough to trigger the reaction.

pages.title: Explosion
pages.text: Drop the items and blow them up.

pages.title: Explosion
pages.text: Drop the items and blow them up.

$(bold)$(o)Nearly any explosion - even creepers - will work.$()$(br2)Always produced in pairs, but only require a single $(item)Singularity$().$(br2)It might be a good idea to label these with names when you create them using the vanilla anvil.
